items.title: Positive Breakout: These 14 stocks cross above their 200 DMAs
items.description: In the Nifty200 pack, 14 stocks' closing prices crossed above their 200 DMA (Daily Moving Averages) on March 25, 2026, according to stockedge.com's technical scan data. Traders use the 200-DMA as a key indicator to determine the overall trend in a particular stock. As long as the stock is priced above the 200-day SMA on the daily timeframe, it is generally considered to be in an overall uptrend. Take a look:

items.title: Hind Rectifiers shares in focus as stock set to adjust to 1:1 bonus issue
items.description: Hind Rectifiers is issuing bonus equity shares. Shareholders owning stock on March 27 will receive free shares. This corporate action increases share count without changing total value. The company reported strong profit and revenue growth. Its stock has seen significant gains over various periods. This move signals financial strength and growth prospects for Hind Rectifiers.

items.title: US Stock Market: An 800-year-old math principle to spot bottom of S&P 500's rout
items.description: The S&P 500 Index faces its worst month in a year. Technical analysis points to a potential 9% drop before finding support. This level, known as the 50% Fibonacci retracement, is a key indicator for traders. Geopolitical events and oil prices add to market uncertainty. Investors watch for resolutions to global conflicts and inflation pressures.

items.title: GIFT Nifty down 170 points; here's the trading setup for today's session
items.description: Indian stock markets saw a strong rally on Wednesday, with the Nifty and Sensex closing higher for the second consecutive session. Gains in banking, auto, and consumer stocks boosted market sentiment. The market experienced a pullback after a recent decline. Volatility is expected to continue due to global factors. The Indian Rupee saw a slight weakening.

items.title: Stocks in news: Chennai Petroleum, LIC, Brigade Enterprises, Sadbhav Engineering, DCX Systems, Aequs, Fino Payments Bank
items.description: Indian stock markets extended their rally for a second straight session, with banking, auto, and consumer stocks driving gains. Several companies, including Chennai Petroleum, LIC, and Brigade Enterprises, are in focus today due to significant corporate developments and announcements.

items.title: Goldman downgrades Indian equities to 'market weight' from 'overweight'
items.description: Goldman Sachs has downgraded Indian equities to 'market weight' from 'overweight', citing slower earnings growth and crude price concerns. The brokerage cut its Nifty 12-month target to 25,900, anticipating downside risks in the next 3-6 months due to unpriced earnings cuts. Despite recent gains, Goldman remains overweight on select sectors but downgraded cyclicals and downstream industries.

items.title: 18 BSE 500 firms outshine FY25 metrics in just 9 months; finance, capex plays lead surge
items.description: Stealing the show: Only 18 BSE 500 firms surpassed their FY25 revenue, EBITDA, net profit and margins in the first 9 months of FY26 l Finance & capital goods cos led the pack amid credit growth and infrastructure push

items.title: MSMEs tap working capital amid rising input cost pressures
items.description: MSMEs and other industries are experiencing higher working capital utilization as input costs escalate due to the US-Israel conflict. This trend, driven by slower cash flows and margin pressures, is prompting lenders to ensure adequate liquidity support. Sectors like hospitality, chemicals, and basmati rice exporters are expected to see increased drawdowns and fresh sanctions as they navigate rising costs.

items.title: CGD stocks slump up to 31% in a year. Can LPG crisis fuel fresh interest in IGL, GAIL, and others?
items.description: City gas distribution stocks have fallen up to 31% amid an LPG crisis, with the government pushing PNG connections. Despite technical weakness, experts see a medium-to-long-term fundamental play due to stable business, though short-term headwinds like supply chain issues persist. Investors are advised to hold existing positions.

items.title: Vedanta shares fall 3% after stock turns ex-date for Rs 11 interim dividend
items.description: Vedanta shares dropped more than 3 percent on Friday. This happened after the stock became ex-date for its Rs 11 interim dividend. The company announced this dividend on Monday. The record date for eligibility was Saturday, March 28. Markets were closed on March 28. This made March 27 the effective record date. The fall also occurred amid broader market weakness.

items.title: UBS picks: Reliance Industries, Adani Ports, among 10 largecap stocks that can rally up to 42%
items.description: Just as confidence in India’s macro story was beginning to build, the energy supply shock triggered by the ongoing Middle East conflict involving the US, Israel and Iran has reintroduced fresh headwinds. With input costs rising sharply and markets turning increasingly volatile, uncertainty around the interest rate outlook has further clouded the near-term picture. Rising oil prices amid ongoing geopolitical tensions are emerging as a key risk for Indian equities, with potential implications for both earnings growth and market valuations. But the brokerage has named 10 stocks that could ride the oil shock. Here’s the full list:

items.title: F&O Radar: Bull Call Spread strategy for Bajaj Finserv
items.description: Bajaj Finserv shows early signs of a trend reversal, holding above key EMA levels and near Rs 1,700 support. Analysts see near-term resistance at Rs 1,800 to Rs 1,870. A bullish options strategy indicates potential upside, with defined risk and reward levels for traders ahead of expiry.

items.title: Stocks to buy: Goldman Sachs lists top 7 quality stocks that look attractively priced
items.description: Goldman Sachs in its latest report on 'India Strategy' highlighted 7 quality stocks with stable earnings and strong balance sheets that look attractively priced, within its preferred sectors. The global brokerage firm, however, turned cautious on Indian equities, downgrading its stance on the market to “marketweight” and cutting its 12-month Nifty target to 25,900.

items.title: ​BPCL, IDBI Bank, among 10 stocks that crashed up to 54% since Iran-US war began
items.description: Stock markets globally have seen sharp downturns in March so far, with Dalal Street being no exception, as the raging war between Iran and US-Israel triggered a skyrocketing rally in oil prices. Here are 10 stocks with market capitalisation of more than Rs 1,000 crore that have fallen the most since the beginning of this month.

items.title: Rs 5 lakh cr wiped off! Sensex slumps over 1,000 points, Nifty near 23K: Rupee at historic low among 6 key factors
items.description: Stock Market Crash: Stock markets fell sharply on Friday, with the Sensex and Nifty declining significantly. The Indian rupee also hit a fresh record low against the US dollar. These movements were primarily driven by fading hopes for a de-escalation in the Iran-US conflict and continued FPI outflows.

items.title: HPCL, BPCL, IOC shares rise up to 4% as govt cuts excise duty on petrol and diesel; what lies ahead?
items.description: Oil marketing company shares are in focus after the government reduced excise duty on petrol and scrapped it on diesel. This move follows a surge in global crude oil prices and a price hike by private retailer Nayara Energy. Brokerages, however, remain cautious, citing potential margin pressures and elevated oil prices.

items.title: Tata Motors PV shares drop 3% as JLR suspends operations at UK plant amid supply squeeze
items.description: Tata Motors PV share price fell 3% on Friday. Production at its luxury unit, Jaguar Land Rover, might be impacted. The Solihull plant faced a temporary shutdown due to supplier issues. This follows a prior cyberattack that disrupted JLR's operations and finances. The company's stock has seen a decline recently. Investors are watching these developments closely.

items.title: LIC shares in focus after insurer gets Rs 7,100-crore income tax demand order
items.description: Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) shares are under scrutiny after the company disclosed an income tax demand order of Rs 7,100 crore for FY22. The demand includes Rs 6,147 crore in tax and Rs 953 crore in interest, stemming from various alleged violations. LIC stated the order is appealable and will not materially impact its operations.

items.title: SIP investors win abroad, lose at home: FY26 delivers a wake-up call on asset allocation
items.description: Indian equity investors faced losses while international funds delivered triple-digit returns in FY26, driven by global tech growth and commodity price surges. While domestic schemes struggled, international investments showcased the benefits of global diversification, though experts advise against chasing past performance and advocate for a balanced portfolio allocation.

items.title: Mankind Pharma shares jump 2% as Morgan Stanley initiates coverage with Overweight call. Check target, upside
items.description: Mankind Pharma share price surged 2% after Morgan Stanley initiated coverage with an 'Overweight' rating and a Rs 2,500 target price, citing strong growth potential. The brokerage anticipates robust revenue and EPS growth driven by domestic business recovery and the BSV segment, favoring Mankind Pharma for its favorable risk-reward profile.

items.title: Sammaan Capital among 8 stocks showing bullish RSI upswing
items.description: From the Nifty 500 universe, eight stocks were highlighted in the RSI ‘Trending Up’ scan on March 25, based on data from StockEdge.com. It is an uptrend signal if the RSI crosses above 50 from below. "RSI trending up" means the Relative Strength Index (RSI) is increasing, indicating strengthening momentum in the stock's price. This can signal potential upward movement and may help traders identify buying opportunities.

items.title: Infosys shares gain over 1% after acquiring two US-based companies for $560 million. Here's what Nomura, Emkay are saying
items.description: Infosys share price gained over 1% rose after announcing the acquisition of two US-based firms, Optimum Healthcare IT for $465 million and Stratus for $95 million. These all-cash deals aim to bolster Infosys' presence in healthcare and insurance sectors, bringing in over 2,000 professionals and enhancing its digital transformation capabilities.

items.title: GE Vernova T&D India among 5 stocks closed crossing above VWAP
items.description: On March 25, the closing prices of five stocks in the Nifty 500 pack rallied by more than 1% relative to their VWAP (Volume Weighted Average Price). A move above VWAP suggests a potential bullish trend, according to StockEdge’s technical scan data.When a stock closes above its VWAP, it indicates the closing price is higher than the average price at which it traded during the session, weighted by volume. Traders often interpret this as a bullish signal, reflecting positive market sentiment and strengthening buying interest.

items.title: ACME Solar shares zoom 8% after Investec initiates with Buy. 4 growth levers behind bullish call
items.description: Shares of ACME Solar Holdings jumped after Investec initiated coverage with a Buy rating and a ₹319 target, implying ~25% upside. The stock has gained about 37% over the past year.

items.title: Jefferies' Chris Wood sells HDFC Bank after Chairman's puzzling exit, cuts India weightage
items.description: Jefferies’ Christopher Wood exits HDFC Bank from key portfolios following concerns triggered by chairman Atanu Chakraborty’s resignation. The move comes amid governance questions, regulatory scrutiny and a broader reduction in India exposure. Global brokerages have also turned cautious, citing macro risks and potential earnings downgrades in the market.

items.title: IREDA declares Rs 0.60 interim dividend, sets record date; shares fall 3%
items.description: Indian Renewable Energy Development Agency (IREDA) shares dipped nearly 3% after announcing an interim dividend of Rs 0.60 per equity share for FY26. The record date for this dividend has been set for April 2. The company also recently increased its borrowing plan for FY26 and FY27.

items.title: Explained: How petrol, diesel excise duty cut may impact HPCL, BPCL and Indian Oil shares
items.description: The Indian government has reduced excise duty on petrol and scrapped it on diesel, offering relief to oil marketing companies amid volatile global crude prices. This strategic move cushions companies from significant losses, allowing them to operate near break-even levels and ensuring earnings visibility and dividend sustainability.

items.title: Buy, Sell or Hold? Morgan Stanley maintains Equal Weight on Infosys; Elara Capital upgrades United Spirits
items.description: Brokerages maintain a constructive outlook on frontline stocks, highlighting growth opportunities and earnings. Infosys faces a balanced view amid acquisitions and margin pressures, while Azad Engineering's strong order visibility and niche positioning are praised. United Spirits sees a rating upgrade driven by value unlocking and improved financial visibility.
